about.heroTitle: Connecting the business of the future.
about.heroSubtitle: Hompra was born with a clear mission: to eliminate the chaos of manual orders and transform B2B commerce into a smooth, fast digital experience.
about.visionText1: In a world where everything is at your fingertips, wholesale commerce has often remained tied to old methods: WhatsApp, endless calls, Excel sheets and lost orders.
about.visionText2: Hompra is the answer to this inefficiency. We created an ecosystem where suppliers and professional buyers can meet, view reserved price lists and complete transactions in seconds, with maximum precision.
about.val1Text: We challenge the status quo of traditional B2B with digital solutions that keep pace with the times.
about.val2Text: We build solid commercial relationships based on transparency and reliability.
about.val3Text: Every feature of Hompra is designed to save time and reduce errors.
about.teamText: Hompra was born in Switzerland from a team with direct experience in the B2B sector. We know what it means to lose an order because of an ignored message.
about.ctaText: Join the companies that have already chosen Hompra to simplify their B2B commerce.

forBuyers.heroSubtitle: Whatever your sector or company size, Hompra brings all your B2B suppliers together in one portal.
forBuyers.feature1Text: No more phone calls or paper notes. Browse updated catalogs from your suppliers, compare and order whenever you want, even evenings or weekends.
forBuyers.feature2Text: Once the supplier approves you, you'll see exactly the commercial terms, discounts and price lists agreed specifically for your company.
forBuyers.feature3Text: Access your purchase history and reorder your usual products in seconds. Zero time wasted.
forBuyers.ctaText: Registration for buyers is 100% free forever.

forSuppliers.heroSubtitle: Forget lost orders on WhatsApp, confusing emails and Excel files. With Hompra, your customers order from your digital catalog 24/7.
forSuppliers.feature1Text: Upload your products. You decide who sees your prices by approving or rejecting customer access requests.
forSuppliers.feature2Text: Different customers, different prices. Set specific discounts or exclusive categories for your most loyal customers.
forSuppliers.feature3Text: Receive orders already formatted and ready for processing in your management system. Save hours of work every day.
forSuppliers.ctaText: Activation takes less than 5 minutes. Start selling intelligently.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.section1Text: Cookies are small text files that visited sites send to your device, where they are stored to be retransmitted on the next visit. They are essential for Hompra B2B to function properly.
cookies.section2TextIntro: We use mainly two types of cookies:
cookies.section2Technical: Technical and Session Cookies (Essential): indispensable for login, cart maintenance and basic preferences. Without these cookies the platform does not work.
cookies.section2Analytics: Analytics Cookies (Google Analytics): used in anonymized form to improve site speed and usability.
cookies.section3Text: You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings. Disabling technical cookies may compromise B2B functionalities (login, cart).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Text: The Data Controller is Hompra B2B, committed to protecting privacy in compliance with the New Federal Data Protection Act (FADP).
privacy.section2Text: We collect personal and contact data, company data (business name, VAT/IDI number, addresses) and browsing data strictly necessary for our B2B services.
privacy.section3Text: Data is used to: manage your B2B account, transmit orders to suppliers, send service communications and improve the platform through aggregate statistical analysis.
privacy.section4Text: Billing data is shared with the chosen supplier to fulfill the order. We do not sell or transfer data to third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.section5Text: You have the right to access, modify, delete or transfer your data. Contact us through the platform's support section or via official email.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Text: These Terms govern the use of the Hompra B2B platform, a marketplace dedicated exclusively to professionals and companies. Access implies full acceptance of these Terms.
terms.section2Text: Hompra acts exclusively as a technology intermediary. It is not a party to purchase contracts. Prices, VAT, shipping and payments are managed directly between supplier and buyer.
terms.section3Text: Use is reserved for subjects with a VAT number or company identification number (IDI). The user is responsible for the accuracy of data and the safekeeping of credentials.
terms.section4Text: The platform is provided 'as is'. Hompra is not responsible for technical malfunctions or the quality or legality of suppliers' products. Any disputes must be resolved between buyer and supplier.
terms.section5Text: Hompra reserves the right to modify these Terms. Users will be notified of material changes via email or through a notice on the platform.
terms.section6Text: These Terms are governed by Swiss law. Competent jurisdiction: Canton of Ticino (Switzerland).

security.metaDesc: Hompra implements cybersecurity measures compliant with EU Directive 2022/2555 (NIS2) to protect B2B customers' data and services.
security.heroTitle:
Your security is
our top priority
security.heroSub: Hompra implements cybersecurity measures compliant with EU Directive 2022/2555 (NIS2) to ensure data protection and service continuity for our B2B customers.
security.measuresSub: Every component of the platform is designed with security as a primary requirement, not an afterthought.
security.m1Desc: Access protected by TOTP (RFC 6238) for all business accounts. Every identity is verified with a second factor before accessing sensitive data and operations.
security.m2Desc: Sensitive data is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM (NIST FIPS 197). Passwords are never stored in plain text — only as bcrypt hashes with cost factor 12.
security.m3Desc: Every access, modification, and critical operation is recorded in an immutable audit trail with timestamp, identity, IP, and unique Request ID for forensic correlation.
security.m4Desc: Automatic lockout after 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes. IP rate limiting. No data revealed for non-existent emails (timing attack protection).
security.m5Desc: Daily backups with Point-in-Time Recovery (RPO ≤ 1 hour). RTO ≤ 4 hours for critical systems. Business Continuity Plan tested twice a year.
security.m6Desc: Critical security patches applied within 48 hours. Public Vulnerability Disclosure Policy (RFC 9116). Annual penetration testing on all exposed surfaces.
security.complianceSub: Our implemented measures are aligned with the leading international cybersecurity standards and current European regulations.
security.docsIntro: Hompra maintains a complete NIS2 documentation package including:
security.docsNote: Documentation is available upon request for enterprise clients and during audits. Contact us at
security.incidentsSub: In accordance with Art. 23 of the NIS2 Directive, Hompra has an Incident Response Plan with the following guaranteed timelines:
security.i2Label: Pre-notification to ACN (early warning) for significant incidents
security.i3Label: Full notification to the National Cybersecurity Agency
security.ctaText: Hompra supports responsible vulnerability disclosure. If you have identified a security issue, we invite you to report it to us confidentially before any public disclosure.
security.ctaNote: We will respond within 48 business hours. Valid reports will be acknowledged in our Hall of Thanks.

apps.ecosystemSubtitle: Integrated digital solutions, crafted with Swiss precision to optimize and scale your B2B business.
apps.hompraDesc: The leading platform for B2B transactions. It facilitates connections between professionals and suppliers, providing a secure environment for managing catalogs, orders, and commercial partnerships.
apps.hompryDesc: The intelligent assistant designed for management excellence. It implements a separate memory architecture for each individual client, fundamentally eliminating any risk of data conflict between clients and suppliers.
apps.cumaDesc: The app for sales agents and commercial teams. Manage clients, product catalogs, quotes, and schedules in a single mobile solution — with catalog import via CSV/Excel, automatic margin and price calculation, professional PDF generation, and instant sharing via WhatsApp, Email, and AirDrop. Sync your catalog and quotes directly with Hompra: every update on Hompra is reflected in real time on CUMA, eliminating double data entry.
apps.spuntDesc: The ultimate tool for field operations. Digitize control procedures through dynamic checklists, ensuring instant sharing of progress updates with the management team.
